notes.title: We’re planning a free update in mid-August featuring training & new stages!
notes.content:
[p]🎮 The demo and full release at Tokyo Game Dungeon were a big hit! 🎉

We’re planning a [b]free update in mid-August[/b] featuring [b]training scenes & new stages![/b][/p][p]We’re hard at work preparing tons of exciting content!

notes.title: ✨An extra stage‼
